category_title: High-ability students with strategic attendance but low platform engagement
scenario_title: Limited engagement with adaptive platform versus strategic LMS resource use
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete introductory algebra assignments on the ALEKS adaptive platform.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the ALEKS adaptive platform and complete the introductory algebra assignments for this week.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I already accessed all the guided notes and study guides in the LMS. I plan to look at them about four or five days before the assessment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think about starting the ALEKS platform assignments now?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I stopped attending the regular class sessions after 3 weeks and missed most of the assignments since then. I am only going to attend the important class sessions like the reviews and exams.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to use the adaptive platform for your coursework.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am not going to use it right now. I will just wait and use the adaptive learning platform for about 2 hours at the very end of the term.
